verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only built-in recurring evaluation rather than general job or workflow scheduling. Alert rules are continuously evaluated and send notifications (grafana-gh-7), and Mimir recording rules periodically create new data (grafana-docs-34). These are glancing forms of recurring automation tied to observability. On-call schedules cover people rotations, not job scheduling, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: a general-purpose scheduler for arbitrary recurring jobs or workflows, user-configurable cron-style schedules, scheduled reports or actions, AI or agent-triggered scheduling, and independent corroboration.
